nodes.signature:
fn {name, count}, current ->
      normalize = fn value -> max(adjust.(value), 0) end
      beans = Map.update(current.beans, name, normalize.(count), fn previous ->
        previous + normalize.(count)
      end)
      %{current | beans: beans}
    end
